description: Run the full keyword research pipeline for a product and return ranked keyword recommendations by composite Jackpot Score (volume, CPC, competition, trend, cluster strength, AI relevance). Backed by real Google Ads Keyword Planner data. Costs $0.10 per call (10¢, regardless of limit). Refunded automatically on pipeline failure. Latency ~60–180 seconds — agents should set generous timeouts.

budget.description: Optional daily ad budget in USD. Influences AI scoring/intent classification.

description.description: Plain-English description of the product (e.g., 'AI keyword research tool for indie makers'). At least one of url/description required.

limit.description: Maximum recommendations to return. Default 50, max 200. Cost is flat regardless.

location.description: Optional location for local-intent boosting (e.g., 'San Francisco, CA').

url.description: Product URL to extract context from (e.g., https://yourproduct.com). At least one of url/description required.

name: jackpotkeywords_recommend
